svg.title: Tinkerer Octocat — Armored GitHub Knight (animated)
svg.desc: An animated flat-vector armored knight Octocat in royal blue plate with cyan circuit accents, a purple cape, a cat-eared helm crowned by the GitHub mark, a wrench-spear staff with a glowing crystal tip, and a heater shield bearing a green CI checkmark. The figure breathes, the cape sways, the helm ears tilt and the crystal staff tip pulses on a gentle loop.
